title: Pseudorandom hypergraph matchings (Ehard–Glock–Joos)
summary: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the main results of Ehard, Glock and Joos, "Pseudorandom hypergraph matchings" (Combin. Probab. Comput. 2020): Pippenger's theorem on almost perfect matchings in almost regular hypergraphs with small codegrees (Theorem 1.1); the existence of a matching M in any r-uniform hypergraph with Δ(H) ≤ Δ, codegrees ≤ Δ^{1−δ} and at most exp(Δ^{ε²}) edges such that ω(M) = (1 ± Δ^{−ε}) ω(E(H))/Δ simultaneously for up to exp(Δ^{ε²}) weight functions (Theorem 1.2, with ε = δ/(50r²)); the generalization to weight functions on ℓ-tuples of edges, under the same…

review.reason: Lean formalization of Pippenger's and Ehard–Glock–Joos's pseudorandom hypergraph matching results.
